# NexusPilot Cortex Documentation

> Cognitive Telemetry, Memory Governor & Context Compression Engine for AI Coding Agents.

## Overview
NexusPilot Cortex is an open-source MCP suite and Google Antigravity plugin providing:
1. Real-time per-response token telemetry badging (In, Cache, Out, Cost, Speed).
2. Autonomous long-term memory management (claude-mem parity) using embedded SQLite.
3. Adaptive context compression (headroom parity) folding stack traces, collapsing repetitive logs, and optimizing Gemini prefix caching.

## Key Links
- GitHub: https://github.com/nishantshaligram/nexus-pilot-cortex
- MCP Tools Catalog: https://nishantshaligram.github.io/nexus-pilot-cortex/reference/mcp-tools
- Quickstart Guide: https://nishantshaligram.github.io/nexus-pilot-cortex/getting-started/quickstart

## MCP Tools Reference
- `render_telemetry_badge(input_tokens, cached_tokens, output_tokens, model, mode)`: Formats token badge.
- `record_turn_telemetry(input_tokens, cached_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, model)`: Logs metrics and computes USD cost.
- `search_memories(query, workspace_uri, limit)`: Semantic BM25 retrieval of persistent facts.
- `remember_fact(fact, subject, category, scope, pinned)`: Saves a memory node.
- `compress_tool_output(raw_output, max_chars)`: Compresses noisy CLI logs, stack traces, and diffs.
- `check_context_headroom(current_tokens, context_limit)`: Checks context headroom against model limit.
